pages.label: Overview
pages.description: Independent catalogue of fruit fly brain simulation projects: what you can try online, what is real, and how to build your own from the FlyWire connectome.

pages.label: Projects catalogue
pages.description: Searchable catalogue of fruit fly brain simulation projects with GitHub code, online demos, licences, setup needs, update dates and evidence grades.

pages.label: Video gallery
pages.description: Fruit fly brain simulation videos: Doom, Minecraft, Beat Saber and Eon demos, each with its evidence grade and what the video does not show.

pages.label: Ways to try the fly
pages.description: Fly brain in a computer: online browser demos, notebooks and no-install options, with the date, device and browser we checked them on.

pages.label: How it works
pages.description: How a fruit fly brain simulation works: the FlyWire connectome and other datasets compared, neuron models, NeuroMechFly (FlyGym) and flybody bodies, and the sense → model → act loop.

pages.label: Is it real?
pages.description: Is the fruit fly brain simulation real? Evidence grades and verdicts on viral claims, separating measured wiring from modelled, hand-made, trained and scripted parts.

pages.label: Build your own
pages.description: Build your own fruit fly brain simulation: a tested beginner guide from an empty folder to a working project, with exact commands, expected output and a shuffled-wiring control.

pages.label: For AI agents
pages.description: Machine-usable instructions for AI agents: stable routes, catalogue record fields, evidence grades, date meanings and the citation rule. No API.

pages.label: Research
pages.description: Index of every Digital Fly Lab research report, with method, sources and limitations.

pages.label: New and updated
pages.description: Dated changelog of new and materially updated fruit fly brain projects, grade changes and site changes.
